messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick sync — internal prep for NovaPay stakeholder review set for Tue 2pm PT. We need a 15-min concise run: 4m ask, 5m demo, 5m health & actions. Who can own what by EOD?
Ibrahim (CS Ops): I can take the usage + anomaly slide. Ill pull last 60d and flag any billing surprises.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Ill own onboarding status + one-pager playbook for their support team. Will sketch the playbook and add quick bullets of common troubleshooting flows.
Derek (Acct Exec): Ill do the executive ask and renewal health summary. Heads-up: customer flagged compliance timelines and unpredictable peak spend as top concerns.
Holly (Product): Note: the routing fallback feature is slated for an internal beta next month; can add a 1-line impact note for reliability.
Maya (CSM): Good. Let's define the top three renewal flags: 1) Compliance review timeline, 2) Unexpected peak spend, 3) Tail latency on quantized path. Add mitigations.
Ibrahim (CS Ops): Mitigations: costs -> cost caps & tags; compliance -> expedited legal review + checklist; latency -> dedicated instance + perf tuning. Ill write one-line mitigations.
Lena (Solutions Eng): For the demo, plan: 0:00-0:30 intro, 0:30-4:00 quick onboarding + live run, 4:00-5:00 fallback & asks. Samir did a smoke test earlier; @Samir can you confirm stability on quant path?
Samir (Eng): (jumping in) Confirmed — ran a smoke test on a dedicated node. Saw a 100-200ms tail with long context; working on a patch, will report Wed EOD.
Derek (Acct Exec): I'll quantify the compliance ask and propose a commercial concession scenario (short-term cost cap) for discussion.
CalendarBot: Prep doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-stakeholder-review/3987654322 (edit access: #customer-success).
Maya (CSM): Action items: Derek: exec ask + compliance quant (Mon noon); Ibrahim: usage slide + annotated spike (Mon COB); Lena: onboarding slide + playbook draft (Tue COB); Samir: stability validation + run link (Tue EOD); Maya: collate slides + dry-run Mon 4pm PT. Please react :white_check_mark: when youre done.
Ibrahim (CS Ops): Reacted. Pulling graphs now.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Reacted. Will drop the playbook mock by Tue AM.
Derek (Acct Exec): Reacted. Drafting the exec slide now.
Maya (CSM): Also capture three customer feedback bullets (3 things they like, 3 pain points). Add one each to the doc.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Added: likes onboarding speed; likes API clarity; pain: edge-case auth flows.
Ibrahim (CS Ops): Added: likes per-route cost visibility; pain: no alert on the March 7 spike.
Derek (Acct Exec): Added customer note: wants predictable monthly spend and a short SLA summary for execs.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Ill send the dry-run invite and a one-page pre-read 24h prior. If anything urgent pops up, drop it here. :rocket:
